about: The postcommunio of the formulary “Saints Philip and James, Apostles” in the 1962 Roman Missal.

seg.tr: Filled with the sacrament of salvation, we beseech You, O Lord, to help us by the prayers of those whose feast we are celebrating. Through our Lord Jesus Christ, Thy Son, who liveth and reigneth with Thee in the unity of the Holy Ghost, God, world without end.
